## Ryan Chitwood

Ryan Chitwood joined the Brookstone Upper School faculty in 2026 and teaches science. A Brookstone Honor Scholar and member of the Class of 2011, Ryan is glad to return to the community that shaped him. As a student, he was taught by Sam Pate, and he considers it an honor to carry on that legacy.

Ryan earned a BS in Ecology and an MS in Wildlife Biology from the University of Georgia. Before returning to Brookstone, he worked in finance at Synovus and held roles at the Physician Assistant Education Association (PAEA) and the University of Georgia.

Ryan's ties to Brookstone span two generations. His wife, Cady, and his brother, Jason, are both graduates, and Jason previously served on the faculty. Ryan and Cady's children now attend Brookstone. A self-described "bird nerd through and through," Ryan looks forward to sharing his interest in the natural world with students, colleagues, and families.
